name: ERCC excision repair 2, TFIIH core complex helicase subunit

function.text: ERCC2 encodes general transcription and DNA repair factor IIH helicase subunit XPD. Annotated molecular activities include ATP hydrolysis activity and DNA helicase activity. It participates in transcription-coupled nucleotide-excision repair and transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to xeroderma pigmentosum group D (autosomal recessive); trichothiodystrophy 1, photosensitive (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Bladder Urothelial Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
